roadmap.landing.heading: A skill tree for {break}real-life goals
roadmap.landing.line: Windmill Roadmap turns a goal or a learning plan into a tree of steps. Each step names what comes first, and finishing one opens the next.
roadmap.landing.trust: No account needed. Your first tree lives in your browser.
roadmap.landing.connect.paragraph: Connect the assistant you already use to a free Windmill account and describe what you want to learn or build. It writes the plan as a tree of steps, and you edit it and do the steps.
roadmap.landing.connect.grantText: Reading, writing and deleting are granted separately, on a screen you approve.
roadmap.landing.connect.editsTitle: Its edits are yours to change
roadmap.landing.connect.editsText: What it writes lands in the tree at once, and you can rename, move or delete any step.
roadmap.landing.connect.publishText: No assistant can publish or share a tree. That stays your decision.
roadmap.landing.unlock.title: What comes first, {break}and what opens next
roadmap.landing.unlock.paragraph: Every step names the steps it needs. Finish one, and the steps that were waiting on it open.
roadmap.landing.unlock.boardText: The Board sorts every step into three columns.
roadmap.landing.unlock.graphText: The Graph draws the same steps as a tree you can pan and zoom.
roadmap.landing.unlock.loopsText: A prerequisite that would run in a circle is refused, in words.
roadmap.landing.start.title: Three ways {break}to start a tree
roadmap.landing.start.paragraph: Name a goal and add steps by hand, pick one of nine ready paths, or paste a list you already have. A pasted outline shows a count of its steps before it is planted.
roadmap.landing.start.pathsText: Four for developers and five for everything else. Three are adapted from the roadmap.sh community maps (CC BY-SA).
roadmap.landing.start.pasteText: A to-do list, an outline or markdown checkboxes.
roadmap.landing.start.laterText: Paste again under any step of a tree you already have.
roadmap.landing.step.title: One step {break}at a time
roadmap.landing.step.paragraph: Open a step to see what it requires and what it opens. Keep your own subtasks, notes and links there, marked private to you.
roadmap.landing.step.treesText: A step can open a tree of its own, and is done when that tree is.
roadmap.landing.step.findText: Find a step, filter by kind, or view one branch.
roadmap.landing.step.phoneText: Below tablet width the Board becomes one column behind tabs.
roadmap.landing.publish.title: Publish a tree, {break}or keep it
roadmap.landing.publish.paragraph: A tree is private until you publish it, and publishing needs a free account. Anyone with the link can then read it, and it can appear in the public gallery.
roadmap.landing.publish.forkText: A reader copies every step with the progress cleared, after signing in or through an emailed link.
roadmap.landing.publish.galleryText: Trees their owners published, ranked by how often they were copied.
roadmap.landing.publish.privateText: Make private sits in the same place as Publish.
roadmap.landing.account.title: No account {break}to begin
roadmap.landing.account.paragraph: Your first tree is saved in your browser. Sign in when you want it on another device, and the trees you made are offered to your account.
roadmap.landing.account.offlineText: Edits made offline wait and sync.
roadmap.landing.account.exportText: Export every tree as Markdown, signed in or signed out.
roadmap.landing.account.freeText: Everything you do by hand is free.
roadmap.landing.limits.title: What it {break}will not do
roadmap.landing.limits.paragraph: Windmill Roadmap never makes you sign in before you can make something, and never publishes anything by accident.
roadmap.landing.limits.colourText: A step’s colour is its kind. Progress is shown as locked, available or done.
roadmap.landing.limits.shareText: A tree becomes public only after you read what that means and decide.
roadmap.landing.limits.editText: Only you can change your tree. Others read it or fork their own copy.
roadmap.landing.data.title: What stays in your browser, {break}and what does not
roadmap.landing.data.paragraph: Signed out, your trees stay in this browser. Signed in, the trees you sync are stored on Windmill’s server with your email address.
roadmap.landing.data.publishedText: Its steps, title and guide are readable by anyone with the link.
roadmap.landing.data.assistantText: It sees only the levels you granted.
roadmap.landing.data.othersText: Cloudflare carries every request, Resend sends the sign-in email, Google signs you in if you choose it, Amplitude counts usage and Sentry receives error reports.
roadmap.landing.runs: Windmill Roadmap runs in a web browser, on a computer or a phone. There is no Roadmap phone app.
roadmap.landing.questions.title: Questions
roadmap.landing.questions.whatAnswer: A map of steps where each step names what has to be finished first. Finishing one opens the steps that depend on it.
roadmap.landing.questions.makeQuestion: How do I make a skill tree for a real-life goal?
roadmap.landing.questions.makeAnswer: Name the goal, list the steps, and mark what each one needs first. Or paste an outline, or start from a ready path.
roadmap.landing.questions.breakQuestion: How do I break a big goal into steps?
roadmap.landing.questions.breakAnswer: Work backward. For each step ask what must be done before it, until you reach something you can do today.
roadmap.landing.questions.firstAnswer: Whatever has nothing unfinished before it. The Board lists those steps under Up next and the rest under Locked.
roadmap.landing.questions.textQuestion: Can I create a skill tree from text, or have an AI write it?
roadmap.landing.questions.textAnswer: Paste a to-do list, an outline or markdown checkboxes. With a free account, an assistant you connect can write the tree.
roadmap.landing.questions.freeQuestion: Is it free, and do I need an account?
roadmap.landing.questions.freeAnswer: Everything you do by hand is free, and the first tree lives in your browser with no account. Publishing a tree and connecting an assistant need a free account.
roadmap.landing.questions.othersQuestion: Can other people use my tree?
roadmap.landing.questions.othersAnswer: Only if you publish it. Then anyone with the link can read it and fork their own copy.
roadmap.scene.stepAbout: Turn the bow through the wind and settle onto the new tack without stalling.
roadmap.scene.stepNote: Look where you want to go. The boat follows your eyes.
